description: Orders up to 100 documents by relevance to a query through POST /v1/rerank with a rerank model id from list_models (type rerank): each result's index into documents, its score and its text, best first. Billed per input token to the key in the MCP request's Authorization header.

model.description: A rerank model id from list_models (type rerank).

query.description: What the documents are ranked against.

top_n.description: How many to return, best first. Default: all.

name: rerank
title: Rank documents by relevance
